summary_en: 3,300,000 shares up to ¥3.0B, 5.6% of shares outstanding, open-market acquisition Sept 7 – Nov 20, 2026. All acquired shares to be cancelled on Dec 10, 2026. Authorized under medium-term plan AIDA Growth 30.
title_en: Notice of determination of matters relating to acquisition of treasury shares and notice of cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: AIDA Engineering's board authorized a treasury share acquisition of up to 3.3 million shares with a combined ceiling of ¥3.0 billion, representing 5.6% of shares outstanding (calculated as 3,300,000 ÷ 58,644,092 ex-treasury). The shares are to be purchased on the Tokyo Stock Exchange through open-market acquisition between September 7 and November 20, 2026. All shares acquired under this program are to be cancelled on December 10, 2026. The company states the action is undertaken to advance enterprise value in line with its medium-term plan AIDA Growth 30, which sets out a framework for growth investment and shareholder returns.
